messages.author: c81250d882e23656
messages.subject: installation issues under R-3.1.2
parts:
Hello -

I'm trying to build out methyKit on a freshly built R-3.1.2 base.  Both ways are failing for me:

1. after downloading the package, via install.packages("methylKit_0.9.2.tar.gz",repos=NULL,type="source"):

Error : objects ‘DataFrame’, ‘Rle’, ‘elementMetadata’, ‘elementMetadata<-’ are not exported by 'namespace:IRanges'
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘methylKit’

2. trying the dev version, via install_github("al2na/methylKit",build_vignettes=FALSE):

Downloading github repo al2na/methylKit@master

 *** caught segfault ***
address (nil), cause 'memory not mapped'

Traceback:
 1: .Call("R_curl_easy_getinfo", curl, as.integer(which), PACKAGE = "RCurl")
 2: RCurl::getCurlInfo(x[[1]])
 3: last_request(handle)
 4: structure(list(...), class = "response")
 5: response(url = last_request(handle)$effective.url, status_code = last(headers)$status,     headers = last(headers)$headers, all_headers = headers, cookies = cookies(handle),     content = content, date = date, times = request_times(handle),     request = request)
 6: perform(handle, writer, method, opts, body)
 7: make_request("get", hu$handle, hu$url, config)
 8: httr::GET(url, ...)
 9: download(dest, src, auth)
10: remote_download.github_remote(remote, quiet = quiet)
11: remote_download(remote, quiet = quiet)
12: FUN(X[[1L]], ...)
13: vapply(remotes, install_remote, ..., FUN.VALUE = logical(1))
14: install_remotes(remotes, ...)
15: install_github("al2na/methylKit", build_vignettes = FALSE)

Possible actions:
1: abort (with core dump, if enabled)
2: normal R exit
3: exit R without saving workspace
4: exit R saving workspace

I obviously need to exit R at this point, but after starting back up again and loading devtools and RCurl (since those were both mentioned in the traceback, this is my sessionInfo():

R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)

locale:
 [1] LC_CTYPE=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NUMERIC=C
 [3] LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8        LC_COLLATE=en_US.UTF-8
 [5] LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8    LC_MESSAGES=en_US.UTF-8
 [7] LC_PAPER=en_US.UTF-8       LC_NAME=C
 [9] LC_ADDRESS=C               LC_TELEPHONE=C
[11] LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8 LC_IDENTIFICATION=C

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base

other attached packages:
[1] RCurl_1.95-4.4 bitops_1.0-6   devtools_1.6.1


Anyone have any suggestions for me?

Thanks!

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] installation issues under R-3.1.2
parts:
The old tarballs will not work for R 3.1.2. The only way to install this is through devtools::install_github. But your problem seems to be about Rcurl package, it probably fails during download. You can try to re-install RCurl and devtools, and see if it helps to resolve the problem. Install_github() worked for me just now when I tested.

Best,
Altuna
